message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: defendant Wang2 gave cash 20,000 RMB to Wang3 (the then director of health bureau) to seek job promotion (position adjustment). This is bribery: giving money to a public official to obtain a favor (position). The defendant is the bribe giver, i.e., "行贿" (bribery). In Chinese criminal law, "行贿罪" (giving bribe). The examples: earlier they had "受贿" for receiving bribe, "单位行贿" for unit bribery, "行贿" for individual bribery. So answer: 行贿.

Thus output: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
